_method: POST with folder_token (send path) + POST without it (control), each read back from GET /open-apis/drive/v1/files?folder_token=<target>
_verdict: OUTCOME = HONOURED_KEY_CONSUMED_PLACEMENT_UNDISCRIMINATED. A copy carrying folder_token='nodlgExampleee5c77c8ba65b63' answered code=0 msg='success'; the target folder's own listing DOES hold the copy (1 children scanned). The control — the same copy without the key — answered code=0 and is ALSO in that folder, so the bot's root IS the default destination and placement alone cannot credit the key. The two bad values answered code=1254702 ('DriveNodeNotExist', a folder that does not exist) and code=1254702 ('DriveNodeNotExist', a real Drive object that is not a folder). code:0 alone decided nothing here (R12); the folder listing and the bad-value legs did.
_note: AC1 gate, three-way. REJECTED or ACCEPTED_AND_SILENTLY_IGNORED => the parameter is NOT shipped and the measured refusal is recorded (AC2 fork (i)/(iii)); HONOURED (incl. …_PLACEMENT_UNDISCRIMINATED, where the bad-value legs prove the key is consumed but this tenant offers no second folder to place into) => ship it matching create_app's spelling (fork (ii)). INDISTINGUISHABLE means neither could be shown — treated as not-honoured for shipping purposes.
_transport: larkdocio.common.transport.CredentialedRawHttpClient (urllib), paced 1.3 s — the RAW core, because the question is what the server does
_disposable: one harness-created source Base + every copy it made, each recorded in the durable ledger BEFORE being read and swept by close_out()
